notes.subject: matsatsi/mengwaga
notes.rationale: Palo-ya-dikgopolo e bapantšha 'matsatsi a go sotlwa' le 'mengwaga ya go bona bobe' — tekanyo ye e swanago, go aga mothapo wa sesupo.

notes.subject: go lekana
notes.rationale: כ (bjalo ka) e fetošetšwe 'go lekana le' go bontšha tekanyo ya go lekana ga mengwaga, e sego go swana fela.

translation: O re thabise go lekana le matsatsi ao o re sotlego ka wona, le mengwaga yeo re bonago bobe ka yona.

tokens.gloss: ao o re sotlego ka wona
